subject: Evidence request: EdgeBank private VPC penetration test scope & remediation
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@edgebank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: 2026-07-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Pen test details for EdgeBank private VPC deployment

Hi Grace / Neha,

Thanks for the quick onboarding last week. As part of EdgeBank's procurement security review we need a few deliverables tied to the private deployment you have for us (VPC-hosted, customer-owned subnets):

- The penetration test report (redacted where necessary) that covers the instance(s) serving our inference workload. We need to understand scope and severity classification.
- A clear statement of boundary assumptions: what Redwood ran inside our VPC vs. tests initiated from Redwood's public endpoints; which IP ranges/hosts were targeted; whether any agent/bastion was deployed in our account.
- Evidence that the two critical findings listed in your preliminary notes (auth bypass on the internal control plane and egress rule misconfiguration) have been mitigated — e.g., retest logs, remediation ticket IDs, or screenshots of firewall/security group changes.
- Network diagram showing segregation between EdgeBank subnets and any Redwood-managed components.

We also need to confirm whether the vendor report (if performed by a third-party) can be shared directly with our security team or if it must go through Redwood for redaction. Attached is a short doc that outlines the artifacts we need and the timeline (we're aiming to finish vendor review by July 20).

Can you confirm what you can deliver by July 13 and whether a quick 30-min call with your engineering lead + RedTeam Labs is possible early next week?

Thanks,

Anita Shah
Senior InfoSec Manager, EdgeBank
Anita.Shah@edgebank.com
(External attachment: EdgeBank-evidence-request-20260710.docx)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@edgebank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pen test details for EdgeBank private VPC deployment

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide the artifacts you requested. Quick notes / clarifications: 

- Sharing: RedTeam Labs (our third-party vendor) produced the raw report. We can provide either (A) the vendor report redacted for any customer-identifying IPs and secrets, or (B) a Redwood-curated evidence bundle that includes the redacted report, remediation tickets, and retest logs. Please confirm which you prefer.

- Boundary assumptions: For EdgeBank's deployment we performed a hybrid assessment – an agent/runner was deployed within your VPC (with your consent) to validate host-level issues, and we also executed external black-box checks from RedTeam's internet vantage. We'll provide a scope matrix that indicates which tests were performed from inside the account vs externally.

- Artifacts we can deliver by July 13 (ETA):
  * Redacted PT report (PDF)
  * Scope & boundary document (PDF)
  * Network diagram (PNG/PDF)
  * Remediation ticket list + links to internal tickets (CSV/XLSX)
  * Re-test logs (text artifacts / timestamps)

- On your critical findings: we patched the auth bypass vector (ticket RWI-9876) and tightened egress rules (RWI-9890). Dev will include re-test evidence (screenshots + logs).

Happy to set a 30-min call — suggest Monday 2026-07-13 10:00am PT. Does that work for you?

Best,

Grace O'Connor
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: RE: EdgeBank - VPC Pen Test Deliverables

Forwarding vendor artifacts from RedTeam Labs. See forwarded message + attachments below — I pulled the raw report and the remediation log they produced after the July 8 retest. I've redacted any EdgeBank customer IPs in the files attached here; full unredacted copies are held by RedTeam.

--- Forwarded message ---
From: pen-tests@redteam-labs.com
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: EdgeBank - VPC Pen Test Deliverables

Hi Dev / Redwood team,

Attached: RTLabs-EdgeBank-PT-report-raw.pdf (raw findings), edgebank-pt-remediation-log-20260712.xlsx (ticket + retest evidence). Summary: 
- Scope: internal agent in-customer-VPC (deployed into EdgeBank-managed subnet per signed scope), plus external black-box testing against public endpoints.
- Targets: bastion host (bastion.edgebank.internal), inference runtime nodes (inference-01..n), control-plane endpoints (control.redwood.api).
- Notable findings (high/critical):
  1) Auth bypass on an internal control-plane endpoint — CWEs related to insufficient access checks.  (Confirmed fixed; retest 2026-07-11 shows no auth bypass).
  2) Egress rule allowed outbound to excessive destinations — security groups updated to whitelist required CIDRs only (retest confirmed).
- Re-tests: RT ran validation scripts on 2026-07-11 and 2026-07-12; logs attached.

We can provide either redacted copies for EdgeBank or coordinate direct delivery to EdgeBank's security mailing list if Redwood prefers.

Regards,
RedTeam Labs
pen-tests@redteam-labs.com
(External attachments: RTLabs-EdgeBank-PT-report-raw.pdf, edgebank-pt-remediation-log-20260712.xlsx)

--- End forwarded message ---

Dev

Redwood Inference
From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@edgebank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pen test details for EdgeBank private VPC deployment

Grace / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and for routing the vendor artifacts. A few quick clarifications before we close the review: 

1) Can RedTeam confirm the public IPv4 ranges used for the external scans (we only need ASN/CIDR level, not specific hosts) so our network team can match with firewall logs?
2) In the remediation log, ticket RWI-9876 references a library upgrade; can you provide the exact package name + version (we track CVE matches).

If those two items are included in the redacted bundle, we're good to complete the internal sign-off. Monday 10am PT works for the call — I'll send the invite to the participants listed.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Anita Shah
Senior InfoSec Manager, EdgeBank
